test_title: PYST 34: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 1 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

His wife is expecting a child and we expect some _________ news soon.
solution:
The correct answer is **"good."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Good news"** is a commonly used collocation in English.</li
